prompts.name: 江南烟雨
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a finished environment painting for the background of a Chinese wuxia turn-based card battle, replacing primitive vector art. Landscape 3:2 composition. Rich but restrained painterly digital matte painting, tangible aged stone, foliage and mist, elegant atmospheric depth, sophisticated hand-painted Chinese martial arts game art. NOT a vector illustration, NOT polygon art, NOT a UI mockup. View from a slightly elevated eye level, a quiet open combat space in the lower middle and the landmark centered in the middle distance so the central 55% also works as a portrait crop. Muted mid-dark values, soft diffuse light, limited local contrast and low visual noise; detail concentrated toward the edges, with readable silhouettes of the scenery. The foreground will have character portraits and small numbers overlaid, so do not add harsh bright spots or busy high-contrast branches through the center. No people, no creatures, no weapons in foreground, no cards, no interface, no text, no calligraphy, no logos, no watermark. Produce only the scene painting, edge to edge. Scene: Jiangnan in a gentle dawn drizzle. A mossy stone terrace by a calm stream, a graceful old arched stone bridge centered in the middle distance, weeping willow branches at the outer left edge, a small traditional dark-tiled waterside pavilion on the right, misty green mountain silhouettes layered far behind. Damp flagstones reflect a very subdued gray-green sky. Deep moss greens, jade gray, weathered pale stone, warm muted wooden accents. Peaceful, poetic and lived-in; believable detailed painting, not flat symbols.
